label: late original-phase step after q/1/a/y/n/l/0
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t >= 4) & isin(prev_tok, [tok("q"), tok("1"), tok("a"), tok("y"), tok("n"), tok("l"), tok("0")])
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase at positions t>=4 (99.7% of mass; peak at t=5-6, rate ~0.3), never at t<=2, almost never at <DEL>, never in the copy phase. Within that window, firing is strongly modulated by the previous input token: prev_tok q (4.8x lift), 1 (4.7x), a, y, n, l, 0 give the highest rates, and the top activations typically come right after a q or 1 (e.g. ... q [q] [p:1.00]). Activation also lingers for a step or two after such tokens (prev2_tok q/1 have lift too), and is higher on first occurrences of the current token. Position window alone gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.22; adding the prev-token set gives F1 ~0.66, mass recall ~0.82. Residual activations are weak and occur after other tokens late in the input.
